core_principles.text: Stand in an erect position with dumbbells at the sides, shoulder blades pulled back and down, and feet hip-width apart with toes pointed straight ahead.
Take an exaggerated step forward keeping feet hip-width apart with toes pointed straight ahead.
Sit the hips down until the front thigh is parallel with the floor.
Maintain balance and push through the heel of the front foot to return to the start position.
Ensure that the hips and shoulders remain square to the direction facing throughout the entire lift.
Keep weight on the front heel and keep the back heel pointed to the sky.
Do not allow the front knee to go forward past the toes.

common_mistakes.text: Allowing the back heel to roll to the side instead of keeping it pointed to the sky.
Allowing the front knee to go forward past the toes during the descent.
Failing to lower the hips until the front thigh is parallel to the floor.

specific_findings.text: During the forward step lunge, the torso should come forward to a 35 to 45 degree angle with the back flat and straight.

core_principles.text: Take an exaggerated step forward with one leg, keeping the toes pointed straight ahead.
Sit the hips and knee down until the front thigh is parallel with the floor.
The torso should come forward to a 35 to 45 degree angle with the back flat and straight.
Maintain balance as you push off with the back leg and step all the way through to the next lunge.
Ensure that the hips and shoulders remain square to the direction facing throughout the entire lift.
Keep weight on the front heel and keep the back heel pointed to the sky to prevent it from rolling to the side.
Do not allow the front knee to go forward past the toes.
Avoid taking a middle step for balance as you step through to the next repetition.

common_mistakes.text: Allowing the front knee to go forward past the toes during the lunge.
Allowing the back heel to roll to the side instead of keeping it pointed to the sky.
Taking an extra middle step for balance when stepping through to the next repetition.

specific_findings.text: During the lunge, the torso should come forward to a 35 to 45 degree angle.
